test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

The partners ended up being __**traitorous **__to each other.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Faithful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"traitorous"** means someone who betrays trust or is disloyal to someone or something. (विश्वासघाती)

 
 
• **Example: **He was considered traitorous for leaking confidential information to the rival company.
 
 
 
• **"Faithful"** refers to someone who is loyal and steadfast in allegiance or duty. (वफादार)
 
 
• **Example: **She remained faithful to her friends even in difficult times.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'traitorous' **is **'faithful'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Faithful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prudent** (विवेकी): Acting with or showing care and thought for the future.

 
 
• **Example:** It is prudent to save money for a rainy day.
 
 
 
• **Disloyal** (अविश्वासी): Failing to be loyal to a person, country, or organization.
 
 
• **Example: **He was disloyal to his employer by sharing company secrets.
 
 
 
• **Fickle** (अस्थिर): Changing frequently, especially in regards to one's loyalties, interests, or affection.
 
 
• **Example:** The fickle weather made it hard to plan outdoor activities.
